name: masheev
description: Integrate Masheev into your applications and work your Masheev customer inbox: triage conversations, draft replies a human approves, and tune AI agents. Connects to the hosted Masheev MCP server with OAuth.

interface.shortDescription: Work your customer inbox and AI agents
interface.longDescription: Find and organise customer conversations, draft replies that are sent only after you approve them, and tune your Masheev AI agents. Sign in with OAuth and choose one workspace and its permissions on the consent screen. Billing, irreversible deletes and credentials are not available.
defaultPrompt: Which Masheev conversations need a human today?
Draft a reply to the latest open conversation and show it to me before sending.
Why did my AI agent escalate so many conversations this week?
